game.title: Fable III
game.blurb: Fantasy action RPG set in Albion half a century after Fable II, in which the ruler's sibling leads a revolution, from Lionhead Studios, released 2010-10-25. RAWG average playtime: 8 hours. Genres: Action, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Fandom and StrategyWiki page names, since there is no Steam achievement list.

StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Fable_III

notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has a page at completion stage 0; only Achievements (about 8,900 characters), Controls (about 1,900) and a very short Table of Contents (about 280) are written, and Walkthrough and Gameplay are linked but not written. So nothing was recorded in sw-structure.json and swUsed is off. fable.fandom.com answers the API, with about 72 linked pages, including "Road to Rule", "Guild Seals", "Real Estate", "Gnomes", "Demon Doors", "Traitor's Keep", "Understone Quest Pack" and "Fable III Storyline"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. RAWG's entry is the 2010 game (id 28631, slug fable-3) and RAWG lists Traitor's Keep and the Understone Quest Pack as separate DLC entries. Chapters are grouped from Fandom page names only (the StrategyWiki contents page is nearly empty) and need checking against play.
